topics: Deterministic Finite Automata as Language Acceptors (DFA)
Nondeterministic Finite Automata (NFA) and Linguistic Equivalence to DFA
State Equivalence and Minimal State DFA
Algorithms for the DFA and NFA
Properties of and Algorithms for Context Free Languages
learning_outcomes: Students will be able to define formal languages, automata, and grammars.
Students will understand how DFA's are used as language acceptors.
Students will learn about NFA's and their equivalence to DFA's.
Regular Expressions (RE) and their applications will be covered.
Relationship between RE and NFA will be discussed.
Properties of regular languages will be explained.
State Equivalence and Minimal State DFA will be introduced.
Algorithms for DFA and NFA will be studied.
Context-Free Grammars (CFG) and their applications will be covered.
Parse Trees and Applications will be discussed.
Ambiguity in Grammars and Languages will be explained.
Pushdown Automata (PDA) and their properties will be introduced.
Relationship between CFG and PDA will be discussed.
Deterministic Context-Free Languages will be explained.
Properties of and Algorithms for Context Free Languages will be covered.
Determinism and Parsing will be discussed.
Introduction to Turing Machines will be given.
